# Character Background This guide will explain the Background and Journey pages of character creation, which decide where your character comes from and give them a head start in the Threshold.
## Creating a Character Before a new character can be finalized you must [bold]set a name, complete the Background page and complete the Journey page[/bold]. Pressing 'Finalize and Join' saves the character permanently, so choose carefully.
Every choice lists its effects underneath its description. These effects are applied when the character first arrives in the Threshold.
## Background Page
### Alignment Your character's moral alignment, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil. Your character gains a trait matching their alignment.
### Universe of Origin The universe your character comes from, which decides who controls the Threshold in their homeworld: [bold]Zenith Universe[/bold]: Controlled by the Solar Legion. A suitable choice for characters from past Persistence 14 iterations. [bold]Green Universe[/bold]: Controlled by Nanotrasen. A suitable choice for traditional SS14 characters. [bold]Marine Universe[/bold]: Contested between the United Nations and an endless horde of hostile aliens. A suitable choice for RMC characters. [bold]Precursor Universe[/bold]: Controlled by the corporations of the Syndicate. A suitable choice for roguish characters. [bold]Shadow Universe[/bold]: Controlled by malevolent entities that manipulate mortals to do their bidding. An unusual origin.
Your universe of origin grants a trait and unlocks a Codex entry related to that universe.
### Motive Why your character came to the Threshold: [bold]Wealth[/bold], [bold]Power[/bold], [bold]Secret Knowledge[/bold], [bold]Friendship[/bold] or [bold]Enlightenment[/bold]. [bold]Wealth[/bold]: Arrive with an additional $2000. [bold]Power[/bold] and [bold]Friendship[/bold]: Arrive with an additional rumor. [bold]Secret Knowledge[/bold] and [bold]Enlightenment[/bold]: Unlock a Codex entry.
## Journey Page The Journey page introduces the lore of the Threshold and Nexus Space.
### Turning Point The moment that changed everything and brought your character into Nexus Space, such as being chosen for the Nexus, being suddenly disgraced, or an encounter with a Magician, Priestess or Rationalist. Every turning point grants the [bold]Freelancer Pledge[/bold] trait, as everyone who enters Nexus Space must do so as an independent.
## Viewing Your Traits The traits your character has gained can be viewed in the 'Traits' tab of the character menu.
